brief:
Formula One star Lewis Hamilton toured Egypt's Rafah border crossing on Tuesday, meeting with aid workers involved in humanitarian relief efforts for Gaza, an Egyptian government statement confirmed. The visit came as the crossing continues to serve as a primary entry point for assistance reaching the besieged territory.

Details of Hamilton's specific activities at the border and the duration of his visit were not immediately disclosed in the government announcement.
dek: F1 star Lewis Hamilton visits Gaza border Formula One star Lewis Hamilton visited Egypt's Rafah border crossing on Tuesday and met aid workers delivering assistance to the war-battered Gaza Strip, according to an Egyptian government statement.
title: Lewis Hamilton visits Gaza border aid operations
